name: french-vocabulary
title: French Vocabulary
description: A local-first French vocabulary notebook, confusion workbench, and practice library with WebDAV backups.
author: jianfeng

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse Vocabulary
commands.description: Browse, annotate, compare, and select vocabulary for practice

commands.name: practice
commands.title: Practice Vocabulary
commands.description: Practice spelling, meanings, and noun genders

commands.name: import-vocabulary
commands.title: Import Vocabulary
commands.description: Paste vocabulary from Excel with column detection and duplicate preview

commands.name: groups
commands.title: Confusion Groups
commands.description: Compare and maintain groups of easily confused words

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Vocabulary Dashboard
commands.description: Learning statistics, backups, WebDAV restore, and library health

preferences.name: autoBackup
preferences.title: Automatic WebDAV Backup
preferences.label: Check backup intervals during browsing and practice
preferences.description: Uses JSON increments and periodic SQLite snapshots while a command is running. Configure intervals and inspect status in Dashboard. Restore the remote library first on a new computer.

preferences.name: languageMode
preferences.title: Translation Display
preferences.description: Applies to vocabulary details, comparisons, and practice.

preferences.name: listPOS
preferences.title: List Part of Speech
preferences.description: Show only the first POS, on the right or below the word.

preferences.name: webdavUrl
preferences.title: WebDAV Backup Folder
preferences.description: Full HTTPS URL of a dedicated existing folder. Create the folder on the server first.

preferences.name: webdavPassword
preferences.title: WebDAV Password
preferences.description: App password recommended. Never included in backups.

preferences.name: randomFrdicPercentage
preferences.title: Frdic Probability (%)
preferences.description: 0–100. ElevenLabs gets the remainder. Draw before cache lookup; no cross-provider fallback. Set 50 for an even mix. Defaults to Frdic only until ElevenLabs is configured.

preferences.name: elevenFrenchVoiceId
preferences.title: ElevenLabs French Voice IDs
preferences.description: Comma-separated voice IDs; randomly selected, with separate caches per voice.

preferences.name: elevenModel
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Model
preferences.description: Model ID sent to ElevenLabs; unknown models receive only required fields.

preferences.name: elevenSpeed
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Speed
preferences.description: 0.7–1.2 for legacy Flash/Turbo/Multilingual models only; omitted for v4/v3.
